metadata.description: Third-party skill packs grouped one plugin per family, so each family nests under one name in the command list.

plugins.name: charles-design
plugins.description: Make UI look designed and feel finished: unslop, polish, award-level craft, colour critique and App Store screenshots (Charles Liu, MIT)

plugins.name: charles-editing
plugins.description: Charles' reel pipeline: plan, script and edit talking-head reels, with explainer, pixel-art and 3D visuals timed to the words (Charles Liu, MIT)

plugins.name: charles-qol
plugins.description: Quality of life: explain anything like you're 14, turn any topic into a narrated interactive lesson, and find what's filling your Mac (Charles Liu, MIT)

plugins.name: charles-drops
plugins.description: Specialist skills that go deep on one craft: interface motion done right, poster-like landing-page heroes, and posters for company moments in the Quartr style (Charles Liu, MIT)
